english.content: 雅思开学季词汇：catch up on / back-to-school blues / first-day jitters
english.meaning: catch up on=赶上补上；back-to-school blues=开学焦虑；first-day jitters=首日紧张；get back into the swing of things=重新适应日常；settle into=逐渐适应新环境
english.example: She stayed up late to catch up on her studies. I always get the back-to-school blues after a long summer break. Once I get past the first-day jitters, I can get back into study mode.
english.quizQuestion: After two months of sleeping in, she definitely has the ______ blues. (A. jitters B. post-holiday C. back-to-school D. first-day)
english.quizAnswer: C. back-to-school — 开学焦虑综合症，标准搭配

english.content: 高考核心词族：depend / dependence / independent / independence / dependable
english.meaning: depend v.依靠/取决于；dependence n.依赖；independent adj.独立；independence n.独立；dependable adj.可靠的。固定搭配：depend on / dependence on / independent of（介词of是高频坑点）
english.example: Our plan will depend on the weather. Teenagers should learn to be independent of their families. He is a dependable friend you can trust.
english.quizQuestion: Teenagers should learn to be independent ______ their parents. (A. on B. with C. of D. from)
english.quizAnswer: C. of — independent of为标准搭配，短文改错高频陷阱

english.content: 高考高频短语30组：take effect / give rise to / lead to / result in
english.meaning: take effect=生效；give rise to=引起导致；lead to=导致中性；result in=结果是（具体）；contribute to=促成贡献
english.example: The new policy takes effect from September. Climate change gives rise to natural disasters. Poor study habits lead to low scores.
english.quizQuestion: The heavy rain ______ serious flooding in the coastal areas. (A. took effect B. gave rise to C. led to D. contributed to)
english.quizAnswer: C. led to — 导致严重后果，搭配最贴切

english.content: 高考新增2026词汇：proposal / prospect / protein / profound / prominent
english.meaning: proposal=提议求婚；prospect=前景潜在客户；protein=蛋白质；profound=深刻的；prominent=杰出的显眼的
english.example: He made a proposal to his girlfriend. The prospect of success excites us. The lecture had a profound impact on students.
english.quizQuestion: The scientist made a ______ discovery that changed modern medicine. (A. prospect B. proposal C. profound D. protein)
english.quizAnswer: C. profound — 深刻的发现，搭配最贴切

english.content: 高三一轮复习：depend词族系统串讲+depend on搭配深度解析
english.meaning: depend核心考点：固定搭配depend on/upon，语法填空完形必考；否定前缀in-组成in+dependent+adj/independence+n；独立表达后用of（而非on）是短文改错高频坑点。dependable=reliable同义词替换常用。
english.example: The country gained its independence hundreds of years ago. His dependence on parents gradually decreased. He is a dependable friend.
english.quizQuestion: The success of this project ______ on the effort of every team member. (A. relies B. depends C. bases D. lies)
english.quizAnswer: B. depends — depend on 是固定搭配，注意搭配介词on

english.content: IELTS 2026环境主题词汇：carbon emissions / biodiversity / renewable energy / waste management
english.meaning: carbon emissions=碳排放；biodiversity=生物多样性；renewable energy=可再生能源；waste management=废物管理；sedentary lifestyle=久坐生活；preventive care=预防保健
english.example: Governments need stricter policies to reduce carbon emissions. Deforestation damages biodiversity. Investing in renewable energy is essential for sustainability.
english.quizQuestion: Deforestation can seriously damage ______ in tropical regions. (A. carbon emissions B. biodiversity C. renewable energy D. waste management)
english.quizAnswer: B. biodiversity — 生物多样性在热带森林最易受损，搭配正确

editing.notes: 对专业剪辑师和短剧导演必备升级。本地NPU渲染让B-roll生成接近实时，3D矢量追踪解决旋转主体跟丢的老大难问题，AI声音隔离让嘈杂环境也能拾取清晰人声。一次性升级解决多个专业级痛点。

editing.title: Adobe Premiere 2026革命性更新：色彩模式重塑调色流程
editing.content: Premiere 2026核心升级'色彩模式'：1.剪辑+调色在同一视角下并行；2.大型预览画面实时呈现色彩调整；3.全新UI+风格预设（饱和度/色相/亮度位移组合）；4.团队协作色彩一致性大幅提升。Matt Johnson评价'PR历来最重要一次更新'。
editing.notes: 对专业剪辑师意义重大：调色决策无需切换窗口，认知连贯性+即时决策力双重提升。新参数'位移组合'比传统RGB曲线更直观。适合纪录片/广告/MV类项目。普及型剪辑师暂时可不升级，但学习后调色效率翻倍。

editing.title: 短剧剪辑核心思维：黄金3秒+三幕剧+转场矩阵全攻略
editing.content: 系统化短剧剪辑思路：1.前期策划（占比30%）：黄金3秒悬念前置/节奏密度（15秒一个爆点）/运镜3:2:2:1；2.执行阶段（50%）：基础转场60%（闪黑/叠化/滑动）+进阶30%（缩放/动态模糊/画中画）+限制10%（旋转/故障）；3.节奏控制（15%）：波形关键帧曲线+三幕剧结构。
editing.notes: 完播率从18%提升到35%的实战数据来自探探短剧调整***位置。色彩心理学：冷暖色调切换≤2次/分钟。音乐卡点100BPM+适合轻喜剧，80-90BPM适合剧情类。每屏切换≥2次/15秒是基线。

editing.title: Premiere Pro 2026系统教程：从零构建剪辑思维完整指南
editing.content: PR 2026完整工作流：1.基础操作（快捷键Space/C/V/Shift+K）；2.代理工作流（4K卡顿用H.264低码代理）；3.效果控件关键帧动画（位置/缩放/不透明度）；4.多机位剪辑（创建多机位源序列+数字键切换）；5.高级调色与转场融合。
editing.notes: 适合已上手PR想系统补全的玩家。重点章节：关键帧动画（高级感核心）+多机位剪辑（活动视频利器）。每章附'常见问题排查清单'。零基础建议先用剪映入门再转PR，不要直接啃PR。

editing.title: 手机制作小视频零基础出片：导出参数+配乐比例+字幕优化
editing.content: 手机小视频优化清单：1.转场不超过3种（基础叠化+硬切为主）；2.自动字幕→人工校字+调位置；3.配乐音量≤人声30%；4.基础滤镜强度40-50%避免失真；5.导出参数1080P/30帧/标准码率（抖音/快手/视频号通用）。
editing.notes: 新手最容易踩坑：滤镜拉满+转场过多+字幕挡主体+配乐盖人声+导出参数高导致二次压缩。谨记'少即是多'原则，15-60秒是大众接受度最高时长。该方案适用于日常娱乐个人记录，不适合商用。
